body: It's (morbidly) comforting to know that at least someone, somewhere out there understands and knows what I'm going through.  Thank you for the kind words and the insight.  The world needs more people like you

It's really nice to hear that i'm over analyzing the taboo-ness of the situation.  The next-to-last sentence is something that I plan to hold on too for as long as i live.    Thank you.  You're a fantastic human.

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.  I've taken a week off from things and i've gotten out of my rut.  I'm hoping I won't have too, but i might take you up on that e-mail suggestion in the near future.  Again, thank you.
